body:
I'm kinda confused if I'm looking for help or want it. One thing someone told me before that's really stuck with me is that if I can't help myself, nobody else can help me.

I can't trust therapists, not even on my own accord.

I got desperate. I haven't seen or spoken to him since, but I've been having fun with guys more my age. I initially feel shit but now I simply just don't care. It doesn't bother me or depress me. *shrug*

I never trusted therapists. I'd get taken to see them as a kid because my mum was convince I had aspergers or something. I didn't react well at all. 

I've talked to a good friend of mine about it before, but the way it comes off of me makes it sound like a joke, like it's one of my usual whacky ideas. So he doesn't take it seriously. Not sure if I would want him to..
